start.text: Oh! A visitor — welcome to my little flower shop. Are you new around here?

choices.text: I found an invitation… someone's expecting me.

exploring.text: Then you've come to the right street. Every corner here has a story — some of them might surprise you.

invitation.text: An invitation? My, my… so you're the one. I had a feeling today was special.

offer.text: Actually — could you help me with something? A little blue flower grows somewhere quiet in town. Near water, tucked behind a hedge. Would you find it for me?

accepted.text: Thank you! Try the little alley on the far side of the plaza — follow it to the very end.

later.text: No hurry at all. I'll be here among the petals.

start.text: Any luck yet? Follow the alley past the plaza — the hedges on this street hide more than one secret.
You found it! The little blue flower… you have no idea how much this one means. Or — perhaps one day you will.

closing.text: Keep it in your heart. Something tells me this street has much more to show you.

start.text: The flower is happy here now. So am I. Whoever set your invitation in motion… they knew what they were doing.
